customRules: The shared checkout D:\projexts\moes (/mnt/d/projexts/moes) is the live runtime: the daemon runs from packages/moe-daemon/dist, and every seat launches packages/moe-proxy/dist. Never run `npm run build`, `npm run clean`, `npm ci` or `npm install` there in any package. Never run `npm test` or `npm run test:coverage` in packages/moe-proxy there either, because its pretest rebuilds and cleans dist. Run those commands, and every npm test gate for packages/moe-daemon, moe-proxy or moe-claude-plugin, in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the repo. A plan step that says `cd packages/<pkg> && npm test` means: in that snapshot. JetBrains Gradle gates (under the jetbrains-gradle lease) and the scripts/tests launcher harnesses may still run in place, exactly as their DoD states. A snapshot run of the exact commit is also acceptable for those gates.

Never pattern-kill processes on this shared host. That means no pkill, no killall, no `kill $(pgrep …)`, no `fuser -k` and no killing by name or command-line match. Every seat's wrapper, its heartbeat and poll sleeps, the proxies and other agents' harnesses all run on the same WSL host. Kill only PIDs that your own session (or its subagent) started, by recorded PID. Put this rule in every subagent brief that may manage processes.

Write tracked files only with the main session's own editing tool (Claude Edit/Write, or apply_patch in a one-shot codex exec seat), or a Serena editor from a one-shot seat. Shell writes (heredocs, sed -i, python or node file writes, cp or mv into the tree) and subagent edits leave no TOOL witness. A path that another open task also declares is then HELD at landing, and your change stays uncommitted. Use shell writes only for scratch files outside the checkout.

Gate budget (human decisions, 2026-11-04): a task's verification gate must finish within 20 minutes of wall time on this host. The gate is its checkRefs[0], which the worker runs before complete_task and QA re-runs verbatim. Run only the suites that exercise the changed code, on the engines it affects, in parallel where they are independent. Only the nightly CI run executes everything. The full launcher suites (postflight.sh, and postflight.ps1 via postflight-safe.mjs) and other long whole-repo runs go in neither a task gate nor per-push PR CI. If a scoped gate would still need more than 20 minutes, split the task or the suite instead of exceeding the budget. Plan DoD items that fit this budget.
